subject: refactor(ssh_dotnet): introduce ISshClientAdapter seam for testability
body:
refactor(ssh_dotnet): introduce ISshClientAdapter seam for testability

Add ISshClientAdapter (+ production SshClientAdapter wrapping SshClient) so the
protocol's connection pipeline can be unit-tested with a fake (connect ok /
auth-fail / timeout / cancellation) without a real SSH server. The adapter exposes
native ConnectAsync(CancellationToken) ready for the async pipeline (4c).

SshConnectionManager gains a CreateAdapter factory; ProtocolSshDotNet now holds an
ISshClientAdapter and calls Connect/ConfigureKeepAlive/CreateShellStream/
GetConnectionInfo/Disconnect through it. The tunnel manager still needs the concrete
client, so it receives adapter.UnderlyingClient. CreateConnection (and its tests)
are unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: [Source](https://github.com/joubertdj/mRemoteNG/commit/b2507ffcb6eb6a841d1cc4b62362bf9530955ab2): Refactors an absent SSH.NET terminal stack; our SSH.NET usage is file transfer, leaving this untested adapter without a consumer.
